modules.name: Fly
modules.detail: WASD flight. Space rises, Ctrl descends. The server may correct movement.

modules.name: NoClip
modules.detail: Your character passes through parts. Return to a clear area before turning off.

modules.name: Walk Speed
modules.detail: Local character speed; a server can correct it.

modules.name: Super Jump
modules.detail: Higher grounded jumps; supports JumpPower and JumpHeight.

modules.name: Low Gravity
modules.detail: Less gravity for your character only.

modules.name: Dash
modules.detail: A short forward impulse. Two-second cooldown.

modules.name: Double Jump
modules.detail: One extra jump per airborne sequence.

modules.name: Air Jump
modules.detail: Repeat mid-air jumps with a short cooldown.

modules.name: Self Fling
modules.detail: Launch yourself with a bounded, resettable impulse.

modules.name: Fling Friends
modules.detail: Requires a trusted game-side consent adapter; unavailable in an unmodified third-party game.

modules.name: Slide
modules.detail: A grounded forward burst; 1.5-second cooldown.

modules.name: Spin
modules.detail: A controlled character spin.

modules.name: Freeze Self
modules.detail: Hold your own character in place; turn off to resume.

modules.name: Respawn
modules.detail: Requires an authorized game-side respawn adapter.

modules.name: Return to Spawn
modules.detail: Return to your character's saved spawn position.

modules.name: Spectate
modules.detail: Watch a selected player's character; your body stays put.

modules.name: Free Camera
modules.detail: WASD camera movement. Hold right mouse to look; Space/Ctrl vertical.

modules.name: Wide FOV
modules.detail: Adjust your camera's field of view.

modules.name: Fullbright
modules.detail: Brighter local lighting without changing other players' view.

modules.name: Golden Hour
modules.detail: A warm local sunset preset.

modules.name: Neon Bloom
modules.detail: Soft highlights using Roblox BloomEffect.

modules.name: Cinematic Focus
modules.detail: Depth-of-field camera focus. Graphics quality may affect visibility.

modules.name: Copper Grade
modules.detail: A warm copper ColorCorrectionEffect preset.

modules.name: Avatar Trails
modules.detail: Copper light ribbons that follow your character.
